title: GDPR Cookie Policy Consent Compliance
body:
<!-- 
  Please read contribution guideline first: https://github.com/dnnsoftware/Dnn.Platform/blob/development/CONTRIBUTING.md 
  Any potential security issues should be sent to security@dnnsoftware.com, rather than posted on GitHub
-->
## Description 
I noticed most all sites that are used in EU have to have a cookie consent form added to the site.  I am wondering if DNN is going to add that like it has privacy policy and ToS pages.

## Current result
No cookie consent message

## Expected result
A message and page that makes website portals compliant with GDPR Cookie regulatory rules


## Affected version

<!-- Check all that apply and add more if necessary -->

* [x] 9.1.1

* [ ] 9.0

author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: we have set up a team for GDPR enhancements of DNN - please read http://www.dnnsoftware.com/community-blog/cid/155590/gdpr-compliance-looking-for-volunteers . From my experience, Cookie Consent is currently subject of discussion within EU site owners, and there is no real clear regulation from the EU atm, as ePrivacy directive - which should clarify, how to implement appropriate solutions, has not yet been released by the EU.
